non_blocking: NB-1 legal-reading label: 8 rows carry 'interpretation, not legal advice' in-row; the other changed rows rely on the document-level labels (verification notes lines 3-4, the readiness register, the manifest scope; sync.py drops the overlay's source label). This matches T01's convention (no labelled row at base). A contract-fix could have sync.py append the label to every row it rewrites.

NB-2 fixture coupling: generate_fixtures.py:1247-1249 embeds REGISTER['generated_from'] in IR-COMPONENT-NC-IN-PROCESS and IR-COMPONENT-NC-IN-LLC. The overlay edit that CONFLICT AVOIDANCE (2) gives T03 therefore moves one line in each fixture, the same reconciliation T01 recorded. 308 of 310 fixtures are byte-identical and no legacy fixture changed; probe F1 shows the change is generator output. Acceptable; the lead records the acceptance at merge as for T01. Every future contract-fix overlay edit will hit the same coupling.

NB-3 ADR-0013 line 17 and spec line 1246 still read 'evaluate waveform-playlist v16 (MIT)', and the PR body names T77 but not ADR-0013. The consequence is recorded where T77's implementer will see it: the issue #97 comment of 2026-11-08T01:47:34Z, the register row's verdict_condition naming T77 and its redistribution_blocker, the readiness register, and verification finding 1.

NB-4 _require_sources checks only that some https URL is present, with no tie to a pin or to the manifest, and nothing refuses a non-unverified status inside the 'unverified' class. Probe P6: songecho flipped to confirmed on its arXiv URL alone; it stays research-only.

NB-5 Readiness completeness rests on the overlay's classes: a GPL code_license without the 'copyleft' class sets the boundary flag but is not listed (probe P7). In --check, readiness_problems only adds a named reason to a staleness failure. No current row is affected.

NB-6 Tests: two refusal tests use a bare assertRaises(SyncError) without checking the message. test_an_open_row_must_stay_unverified breaks all three open-row conditions at once. No test drives main(['--check']); CI does, through clean_contracts.py.

NB-7 Process-boundary consistency: librosa-pyin reads false although its own note says its LGPL dependencies (soundfile/libsndfile, soxr) keep it in a worker. soxr and lameenc have no row or class, while T01 classed soundfile, libsndfile and scipy and this PR classes waveform-playlist for an LGPL dependency. The open rows mp3-encoder, lyric-aligner, g2p-phonemizer and midi-synth-soundfont read false while unverified.

NB-8 basic-pitch keeps redistribution_blocker 'None' despite its NOTICE and three non-commercial or academic-only training datasets. That field is not copied into engine profiles, so it could mirror swiftf0's wording until T54 decides.

NB-9 The deferred obligations (Basic Pitch apache_notice; attribution on the MIT, BSD and ISC rows bound to engine profiles) need the contract-fix PR before any export relies on them. The deferral is recorded in the verification notes.

NB-10 CLAUDE.md rule 3: the librosa-pyin note re-commits 'Vocadito pitch F1 0.653 (author-run benchmark)' with no figure label. This is evidence-register text; the swiftf0 row labels the same benchmark VENDOR.

NB-11 Predating the PR: seven rows have status unverified without the 'unverified' class (deepfilternet is allowed in individual and llc; also melodyspec-abc-converter, muscriptor, neutralvoice, prior-art-studios, stepaudio-3-music, studio-own-code). Unchanged from base and outside T03's list; worth a contract-fix check.

NB-12 Judgement calls: _apply_open_rows mutates rows in place; main() builds the register twice; 'register' names two different files; VERIFIED_FIELDS admits 'verdict' but no entry uses it; readiness() re-reads the raw overlay label (fail-closed by the ADR-0035 lint, probe P8); the overlay's 'gate' field holds a ticket, whereas GLOSSARY's Gate is an evidence pass rule.

NB-13 Housekeeping: the PR body's author-written spot-check says '(left UNVERIFIED)' for rows it confirms (the independent line is comment 6716123075); the PR body gives no hosted run id (run 42435568374 is green on abb6826); contracts/README.md still describes sync.py's output as components.v1.json alone; evidence-register.json and RECONCILIATION section 4 still show mido and mir_eval as UNVERIFIED.

NB-14 Lead note: 52 of the 150 files in the implementer's evidence folder contain third-party addresses (registry metadata, NOTICE, OFL-FAQ). A checkpoint PR into ops/mission/evidence must not commit raw/ or licenses/ wholesale.
